package private

import (
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/private/middleware"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

func NewRouter(
	handler handlers.HealthHandler,
	coursePlans handlers.CoursePlanHandler,
	targetCatalog handlers.TargetCatalogHandler,
	practiceLearning handlers.PracticeLearningHandler,
	learningReadiness handlers.LearningReadinessHandler,
	onboardingPlanHandoff handlers.OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler,
	_ handlers.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanHandler,
	diagnosticPlacement handlers.DiagnosticPlacementHandler,
	projectAuthoring handlers.ProjectAuthoringHandler,
	internalToken string,
	teacherToken string,
	teacherOnboardingHandoffToken string,
	practiceToken string,
) chi.Router {
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Group(func(group chi.Router) {
		group.Use(middleware.RequireInternalToken(internalToken))
		group.Get("/health", handler.Get)
		group.Post("/learning-targets/resolve", targetCatalog.ResolveExact)
		group.Post("/learning-targets/candidates", targetCatalog.DiscoverCandidates)
	})
	router.Group(func(group chi.Router) {
		group.Use(middleware.RequireInternalToken(teacherToken))
		group.Post("/students/{studentID}/course-plans", coursePlans.CreateTeacherCoursePlan)
		group.Get("/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessment-plans/{planID}/planning-state", coursePlans.GetDiagnosticPlanningState)
		group.Post("/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessment-plans/{planID}/placement", diagnosticPlacement.Consume)
		group.Get("/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessment-plans/{planID}/placement", diagnosticPlacement.Get)
		group.Post("/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/project-authoring-flows", projectAuthoring.Create)
		group.Get("/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/project-authoring-flows/current", projectAuthoring.GetCurrent)
		group.Get("/students/{studentID}/project-authoring-flows/{flowID}", projectAuthoring.Get)
		group.Post("/students/{studentID}/project-authoring-flows/{flowID}/confirm", projectAuthoring.Confirm)
		group.Post("/students/{studentID}/project-authoring-flows/{flowID}/publish", projectAuthoring.RequestPublication)
	})
	router.Group(func(group chi.Router) {
		group.Use(middleware.NoStore)
		group.Use(middleware.RequireInternalToken(teacherToken))
		group.Post("/students/{studentID}/learning-readiness", learningReadiness.ResolveStudent)
	})
	router.Group(func(group chi.Router) {
		group.Use(middleware.NoStore)
		group.Use(middleware.RequireInternalToken(teacherOnboardingHandoffToken))
		group.Post("/students/{studentID}/onboarding-plan-handoffs", onboardingPlanHandoff.AcceptStudent)
	})
	router.Group(func(group chi.Router) {
		group.Use(middleware.RequireInternalToken(practiceToken))
		group.Post("/practice-learning-routes", practiceLearning.ResolveRoute)
		group.Post("/practice-learning-routes/{routeID}/steps/{stepID}/readiness-reconciliations", practiceLearning.ReconcileReadiness)
		group.Post("/practice-learning-materials/{materialKey}/ensure", practiceLearning.EnsureMaterial)
	})
	return router
}
